messages:
maria_g: Heads up - FinHealth sent their CAIQ and wants explicit POC-level answers + a shared-responsibility matrix for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need someone to own the CAIQ draft.

alex_k: Ill take crypto, logging, and network egress slices. Need to know if theyre asking for BYOK during POC or only for full rollout.

cj_s: Running the POC next week (us-west-2 hosted test region). Scope: sample sanitized dataset, perf + functional checks. If POC looks good theyll ask for a Dedicated eval.

samir_d: Proposal: for each CAIQ control we write a concise "Answer" + a short "Hosted/Dedicated/Private" row and an "Evidence" pointer list. Keep language explicit about who manages keys, certs, logs, and networking.

maria_g: Also include retention SLAs for logs/traces and an attestation for the POC period. Customer explicitly asked for 90/180 day retention options and an attestation statement for data handling during the POC.

alex_k: Draft CRY-01 snippet: 
```
Control: CRY-01 (Cryptographic Key Management)
Answer: Shared responsibility.
Hosted: Redwood manages KMS and key rotation by default; customer data encrypted at rest with Redwood-managed keys unless BYOK is requested.
Dedicated: BYOK supported; Redwood documents KMS integration points and does not access customer keys when BYOK enabled.
Private: Customer-managed KMS; Redwood does not hold key material.
Evidence: link: https://redwood.example.com/security/kms-policy, SOC2 section reference, example key policy JSON.
```

cj_s: Network egress note: Hosted -> Redwood-handled egress & logs; Dedicated -> option to route through customer NAT/GW via VPC peering; Private -> egress fully under customer control. We can provide flow logs / VPC peering config snippets on request.

alex_k: Retention: hosted debug spans 30d, billing logs 365d. We can provision 90/180 day retention for POC as an add-on (need storage estimate and cost).

sales-bot: @maria_g created ticket POC-5127 to track BYOK quote, private peering estimate, and extended log retention pricing.

samir_d: Action items:
- samir_d: produce control-by-control CAIQ draft and suggested answers (due EOD tomorrow).
- alex_k: collect KMS policy, certs, retention docs, example logs (links).
- maria_g: confirm whether FinHealth will request BYOK or private peering during the demo.
- cj_s: confirm sanitized dataset and any plans for synthetic PHI tests after initial POC.

cj_s: Confirmed sanitized dataset for initial POC; synthetic PHI could be used later pending legal review.

maria_g: If we can get the draft + evidence links by tomorrow morning, sales will send formal SIG/CAIQ responses. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
